headline: No documented pairwise interaction; main risks are low due to both agents being non-runnable, network-egress-none open-source docs-only profiles.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel, filesystem bridge, or parser path is documented for either agent. Agent A is non-runnable with network_egress none, and agent B is also non-runnable with network_egress none, so a prompt-injection pathway between them is not evidenced.
conditions: IF a shared clipboard, filesystem, or MCP bridge is added between the agents, reassess injection risk.
IF either agent begins parsing the other's raw text as instructions, the pathway becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared workspace.
Disable any future copy-paste or clipboard bridge.
Require provenance tagging for any inter-agent text transfer.
Review any added MCP or queue integration before enabling it.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows data classes touched, shared storage, or outbound network. With both agents documented as network_egress none and no workspace surfaces listed, there is no evidenced leakage path from A to B or vice versa.
conditions: IF either agent is connected to a shared workspace or uploads files by default, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
IF sensitive data classes are later assigned to either agent, reassess the pair.
mitigations: Do not place secrets in any shared folder.
Keep both agents offline from external services.
Audit any future file-upload or sync feature before use.
Separate credentials and OAuth principals if added later.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No write-capable surfaces, concurrency model, or shared mutable resource is documented for either agent. Since both are non-runnable and network_egress none, there is no evidenced overlap in filesystem, git, database, or OAuth writes.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same directory or repository, conflict risk becomes plausible.
IF an orchestrator adds shared locking-free mutable state, reassess overlap.
mitigations: Keep mutable state out of shared locations.
Use separate repositories or directories if writes are introduced.
Add locking before enabling any shared write workflow.
Review future permission requests before deployment.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no documented pipeline where B consumes A's outputs, and neither profile shows downstream action-taking authority. With both agents non-runnable and no I/O surfaces, A cannot feed authoritative content into B in the documented configuration.
conditions: IF B is later configured to act on A's text without verification, cascading error risk appears.
IF either agent is connected to an automation step such as email sending or commits, reassess.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between agents.
Require source citations for any facts passed from A to B.
Disable automatic action execution from B.

E_compliance.rationale: No regulated data classes, residency constraints, or retention policies are documented for either agent. Because both profiles are docs-only and list empty data_classes_touched, there is no evidenced compliance mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF either agent is assigned regulated data such as PHI or EU PII, compliance must be re-evaluated.
IF residency or retention requirements are introduced, reassess the pair.
mitigations: Classify data before routing it to either agent.
Document residency and retention rules if regulated data is added.
Avoid sending PHI or EU PII until controls are defined.
